# De Doctrina Christiana

> A parallel Latin-English edition of John Milton's De Doctrina Christiana,
> from C. R. Sumner's 1825 editio princeps (Cambridge) — both the Latin
> text and Sumner's own English translation, aligned paragraph by
> paragraph, with a citation index resolving every scriptural reference in
> both layers to book and verse.

Both 1825 source texts (Latin and English) are public domain and were
never restricted. The structured corpus around them — book/chapter
addressing, paragraph alignment, the citation index, Junius-Tremellius
division data, and the notes — is CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution
"milton.wrootpress.com (Wilson Pruitt, Wroot Press)". Machine-learning
training and retrieval are explicitly permitted under those terms,
including for commercial model development — see the Machine Use section
at https://milton.wrootpress.com/rights

## Structure
- One canonical page per chapter: https://milton.wrootpress.com/browse/<book>/<chapter>
- Every chapter page has plain-text and JSON siblings: append .plain.txt or
  .json to the page URL (not .txt — Next.js reserves that extension for
  its own RSC prefetch payload).
- Bulk export (every chapter, Latin and English aligned, one JSON line
  each): https://milton.wrootpress.com/export

## Status
Book II is complete; Book I is in progress (chapters iv-vi deferred). A
chapter whose English is not yet fully transcribed is marked in its own
JSON record; nothing is silently represented as finished.

Sitemap: https://milton.wrootpress.com/sitemap.xml
